create_norm_elevation_dataset: create a small NORB elevation dataset from raw .mat files into train and test folder splits
download_dataset: download and extract the small NORB dataset archives into a specified root directory
parse_small_norb_format: parse small NORB .mat binary files into numpy arrays using little-endian magic number detection
create_disk_folder_split: create disk folder splits from NORB dat and info files organized by elevation class
get_argument_parser: get an argument parser for the small NORB elevation data creation script with input, output, and download flags
